text: {"name":"ble_process_scan_results","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Processes pending BLE advertising reports from a scan-result buffer, advancing through 528-byte scan entries, dispatching each unprocessed entry to process_adv_report, issuing an HCI stop-scan command when needed, and re-enabling or disabling the scan timer based on the current scan/advertising mode fields.","subsystem":"ble","var_renames":{"v2":"scan_ctx","v1":"scan_ctx_base_off","v4":"scan_entry_ptr","v5":"scan_ctx_end","v6":"entry_cur","v0":"scan_abort_ptr","v7":"entry_base","v3":"scan_mode","v8":"scan_mode","v9":"scan_mode"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":6336,"meaning":"scan context / advertising state sub-structure"},{"offset":6338,"meaning":"scan sub-mode byte (5 = active-scan variant)"},{"offset":6339,"meaning":"scan/advertising mode selector (0/1 = timer-restart, 2 = process reports)"},{"offset":6480,"meaning":"scan context index (multiplied by 136)"},{"offset":4,"meaning":"scan entry status (1=pending, 2=processed)"},{"offset":6,"meaning":"scan entry adv-data offset (16-bit)"},{"offset":22,"meaning":"scan entry flag byte (zeroed on process)"},{"offset":24,"meaning":"scan entry counter field (zeroed on process)"},{"offset":28,"meaning":"scan entry payload base for process_adv_report"}]}
